rows.name: sp_set_child
rows.notes: Registration0x4545DF installs code0x30031. Native callback status does not write a VM destination. Eight parent lanes borrow child slot identities. The child shared auxiliary bank stores independent base-scale product differences, integer/float angle differences, and each child color byte minus255. Parent propagation copies effective parent lanes first and adds these deltas. Invalid native lane memory writes are safely rejected.

rows.name: sp_is
rows.notes: Ordinary slots 0..127 check the Game wrapper handle. References >=128 resolve through 0x47ABA0: tag bits 24..27 select ordinary PAL slots (low16+16), raw PAL slots (tag1), or button slots (tag2, group bits20..23, index low16). Visibility and alpha are not existence predicates. Slot -1 writes zero and yields; values below -1 preserve the destination and yield. Invalid native raw references can dereference null; the portable implementation returns zero instead.

rows.name: sp_set_pos_move
rows.notes: Resolves through 0x47ABA0, adds raw integer deltas to wrapper +16/+20/+24 and float deltas to +116/+120/+124. Returns control 1 without writing the VM destination. The packed button path is now implemented; complete ordinary-wrapper transform-bank equivalence remains separately unverified.
